_status: PARTIAL. Only a two-width check on T4 was measured. The full sweep (K = 4096 to 32768 plus 32769, fp16 and fp32, on T4, A10G and A100) was not run: the session's permission layer refused the paid three-GPU launch after the check had completed. A10G and A100 have no measurement. Nothing here covers K = 16384, 32768 or 32769. The T4 object below is the --out JSON of the check as written by modal_app.py; every key starting with an underscore, and not_run, was added by hand afterwards. The unannotated --out file was not kept separately. The check ran before modal_app.py recorded the TF32 setting, so the T4 object has no matmul_allow_tf32 key (T4 has no TF32 hardware; torch's default is off).
_method: modal_app.py::cuda_wide_k_t4 imports bench/repro_mps_wide_linear.py (shipped into the image as a single file) and calls its sweep() with device cuda: same eight variants, same interleaved rounds, min ms over 3 rounds x 5 iterations after one warm-up call per variant, torch.cuda.synchronize() around each call. M=4608, N=6144.
